signals.summary: Review a point-in-time process snapshot observation.

observed_fact_summaries.summary: A relevant process was observed at collection time.
evidence_caveats: Linux.ProcessList is point-in-time; process absence does not prove non-execution.

risk_notes: Missing or limited evidence does not prove non-execution or a benign state.
